records.title: ON THE LIGHTS
pages:
THE STARS ARE NOT OUTSIDE
THE PARTITION.

records.title: THE DEEP, FINAL DESCENT
pages:
BELOW THE LAST SHAFT
THERE IS NO FLOOR.

THERE ARE LIGHTS.
SOME ARE STATIONARY.
SOME ARE MOVING.

ONE OF THEM IS THIS WORLD.
WE HAVE CONFIRMED THIS
BY EXTINCTION.

WE DID NOT CONFIRM
THE OTHERS.

records.title: LIGHT 7
pages:
LIGHT 7 IS CLOSER
THAN IT WAS.

MEASUREMENT IS UNRELIABLE.
THERE IS NOTHING TO MEASURE IT
AGAINST.

records.title: ON PRESSURE
pages:
WE HAVE BEEN WRONG
ABOUT THE FAILURE.

THE EVENTS ARE NOT FAILURES.
THEY ARE RELEASES.

A SYSTEM THAT RELEASES
IS A SYSTEM THAT IS HOLDING.
